home.promptPlaceholderEcommerce: Describe your new product and launch plan, e.g. a $35 noise-cancelling earbuds launch targeting commuters, competing with Brand X, 10 KOLs seeded, on-sale day 7 after announcement. Rehearse buzz and purchase intent.
home.ecommerceTemplate:
[Product Launch Rehearsal]
Product: wireless ANC earbuds priced at $35, 42dB ANC, 60h battery, launch bundle included.
Target audience: commuters aged 25-35 in tier-1/2 cities, monthly budget $300-700.
Competitor: Brand X (priced at $42, market leader).
Plan: pre-order opens day 3 after announcement, on-sale day 7; 10 tech/music KOLs seeded, 2 tech media first reviews.
Rehearsal goals: buzz & sentiment trend, purchase intent & price acceptance, KOL effect, competitor counter-moves.

step1.ontologyDesc: LLM analyzes document content and simulation requirements, extracts reality seeds, and auto-generates a suitable ontology structure
step1.graphRagDesc: Based on the generated ontology, documents are auto-chunked and sent to Zep to build a knowledge graph, extracting entities and relations, forming temporal memory and community summaries
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Graph build is complete. Proceed to the next step for simulation environment setup.

step2.simInstanceDesc: Create a new simulation instance and pull world parameter templates
step2.generateAgentPersonaDesc: Combine context to auto-extract entities and relations from the knowledge graph, initialize simulated individuals, and assign unique behaviors and memories based on reality seeds
step2.dualPlatformConfigDesc: LLM intelligently sets world time flow, recommendation algorithms, each individual's active hours, posting frequency, event triggers, and more based on requirements and reality seeds
step2.initialActivationDesc: Auto-generate initial activation events and hot topics based on narrative direction to guide the simulation world's initial state
step2.setupCompleteDesc: Simulation environment is ready. You can now start the simulation.
step2.roundsConfigDesc: Yanceva auto-plans to simulate {hours} real-world hours, each round representing {minutesPerRound} minutes of elapsed time
step2.customTip: For first-time runs, we strongly recommend switching to 'Custom Mode' to reduce rounds for a quick preview and lower error risk
step2.personaDimExperienceDesc: Complete behavioral trajectory in this event

landing.heroTitle:
Your launch will either work or flop.
Find out which — before you spend.
landing.heroSub: Drop your scenario into a sandbox of 60 AI agents — buyers, critics, competitors, journalists — and watch your market react. Quantified metrics, verbatim quotes, actionable strategy. Delivered in hours.
landing.stat2Label: of signals: volume, sentiment, purchase intent, price sensitivity
landing.howSub: No surveys, no focus groups, no waiting weeks. Just AI agents simulating your market.
landing.step1Desc: Fill a short form. Upload docs if you have them. Tell us what you're worried about.
landing.step2Desc: Buyers, critics, competitors, journalists — each with a unique persona, memory and agenda. They interact, argue and react in real-time.
landing.step3Desc: Quantified metrics, verbatim agent quotes, risk assessments and action items. Delivered in hours, not weeks.
landing.step4Desc: Volume, sentiment, purchase intent, review risks and action items — with verbatim agent quotes
landing.value1Desc: Price backlash? Feature complaints? Trust issues? The simulation surfaces your weakest point before your customers do.
landing.value2Desc: Not all users react the same. See which segments churn, which ones double down, and what tips the balance.
landing.value3Desc: Test your counter-moves in the sandbox. Discount, hold firm, redesign — run the same shockwave with different strategies and compare.
landing.value4Desc: Secondary risks cascade. The simulation maps the chain reaction: media amplification, regulator attention, competitor exploitation.
landing.moreScenariosDesc: SaaS pricing sandbox, brand-crisis rehearsal, listing risk review, creator content risk
landing.finalTitle: Win your next launch in the sandbox first
landing.footerDisclaimer: Rehearsal results are simulated predictions, not guarantees of real-world outcomes
landing.faq1A: Every conclusion comes from conversations and behaviors that actually happened inside the simulation, with verbatim quotes and quantified metrics. But the sandbox is a prediction, not a promise — it helps you find problems and compare options; combine it with other sources for major decisions.
landing.faq2Q: What do I get and when?
landing.faq2A: A report with volume/sentiment/purchase-intent charts, verbatim agent quotes and action items (web view + downloadable file). Standard ~2 hours; Pro (with A/B variants) ~4 hours.
landing.faq3A: Your materials are used only to run your rehearsal (our LLM provider's policy states customer data is not used for training), and the agents are fictional. You can request deletion of your order data and files at any time.
landing.faq4A: Six scenarios are live: e-commerce product launch, SaaS pricing/redesign, brand crisis response, cross-border listing review, competitor launch response, and creator content risk. Each has its own agent personas, event timelines and report templates.
landing.faq5A: International cards / Apple Pay / Google Pay via Creem checkout (we never see your card). Failed runs are retried or refunded — see Terms of Service.
landing.docTitle: Yanceva | AI Business Rehearsal Platform — Simulate Decisions Before You Commit
landing.docDesc: Rehearse business decisions on a sandbox of AI agents. Product launches, SaaS pricing, brand crises, listing reviews, competitor moves, creator content — actionable reports in hours.
landing.insightsSub: Real findings from actual simulation runs — every report contains verbatim agent quotes and quantified metrics.
landing.sample1Quote: AI buyers flagged 'price too high vs AirPro' as the #1 churn trigger. The report recommended repositioning as premium with a bundle, anchoring at $99 instead of $79.
landing.sample2Quote: The simulation mapped a 3-level escalation chain: victim post → media pickup → regulator attention. Script A (4h apology) recovered 73% of sentiment; Script B (24h delay) triggered a 'template apology' second wave.
landing.sample3Quote: 5 reviewers flagged 'Medical Grade' without FDA certification as a takedown risk. The compliance checklist covered claims, certifications and restricted superlatives.
landing.testimonialsNote: Illustrative feedback based on pilot testing. Individual results vary.
landing.t1Quote: Found a compliance issue that would've gotten my listing taken down. The rewritten bullets alone were worth the $19.
landing.t2Quote: The A/B comparison on pricing showed us a 30% churn risk we didn't see. We adjusted the rollout and kept 85% of our beta users.
landing.t3Quote: Saw exactly which user segment was about to churn and why. The response script comparison was eye-opening — we used the winning script in our actual launch.
